test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 20 March, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Choose the word that can substitute the given group of words.

A person who has given up their beliefs
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 3' **i.e.** 'Apostate'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given group of words, "A person who has given up their beliefs" can be substituted by the word** "Apostate".**
 
• **"Apostate"** means a person who renounces a religious or political belief or principle.(धर्मत्यागी)
 
• This is the** most appropriate word **as it directly denotes a person who has abandoned their previous religious, political, or other beliefs.

Therefore, the **correct answer** is: **'Apostate'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the other options:
 
 
• **"Misanthrope" **refers to a person who dislikes humankind and avoids human society. (मनुष्य द्वेषी)
 
• **"Versatile"** is used to describe something or someone that is capable of doing many things competently or a person who has many different skills.(बहुमुखी)
 
• "**Crusade"** is a term that usually refers to a vigorous campaign for political, social, or religious change.(धर्मयुद्ध)
 
 

40:T607,

The correct answer is 'Option 2&am
